change: The FCC's revised consent revocation rules in FCC 26-67 take effect on 25 November 2026. A sender that designates a reply text as the exclusive way to revoke consent must disclose it.
Twilio plans to introduce more specific error codes for rejected US A2P 10DLC campaign registrations. Its changelog entry lists 22 codes in three groups.
49 state and territorial attorneys general asked the FCC to verify Robocall Mitigation Database filings before they go live and to make it harder for removed providers to return.
ASIC published Report 845 with a media release headlined as a final warning to licensees that using lead generators may put their licence at risk. ASIC reviewed 15 financial advice licensees.
The FTC said its staff are sending warning letters to 25 companies that market or generate sales leads for healthcare plans. The letters do not allege any wrongdoing by any of the recipients.

who: Circuit Court of LaSalle County, Illinois
change: A LaSalle County, Illinois court gave final approval to a TCPA class settlement of up to $1.1 million, all costs included, for 853 people called through the AI Rudder calling platform. The defendants deny wrongdoing.
source_name: Final approval order on the court-authorized settlement website

change: Twilio Voice Integrity now covers Verizon too, so it reaches the spam-label engines of all three big US carriers. It previously registered numbers with the analytics vendors for AT&T and T-Mobile.

AGCOM fined Retelit Digital Services 700,000 euro and Tekmind 122,500 euro for failing to check numbers used by call centres, including spoofed ones. Its press release of 12 October 2026 announced the fines.

TRAI announced the Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2026. A voice call that software places without a person dialing it is an A2P call and must be declared in advance.
source_name: TRAI release via the Press Information Bureau

change: The FCC released a draft Report and Order that would let callers designate any of three methods as the exclusive way to revoke consent. The FCC votes on the draft on September 30.
UOKiK fined a telemarketing firm PLN 308,728 and its president at the time PLN 100,000 for calling consumers without consent. The decision is not yet final.

HighLevel's toll-free verification form now asks for a Privacy Policy URL and a Terms and Conditions URL. It says carriers will begin rejecting any new toll-free verification without both links on September 15, 2026.

Telephone prospecting in France is prohibited by default. A call is lawful only if it concerns a contract already in force or the consumer gave prior agreement to be contacted for commercial prospecting.
Article 50(1) of the EU AI Act requires providers to design AI systems that interact directly with people so those people are told they are dealing with an AI, unless that is obvious.
The Bundesnetzagentur fined a call centre €34,327: €32,000 for calls to consumers without consent and €2,327 for incomplete consent records. The fine is not final.
The FCC proposed an overhaul of the Robocall Mitigation Database in a Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking in WC Docket No. 24-213. It was published in the Federal Register on September 9.

Act 47 of 2026 rewrote large parts of Pennsylvania's Telemarketer Registration Act. Sales calls are allowed only 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday to Saturday. Robocalls need written consent and texts are covered.

The Seventh Circuit held in Steidinger v. Blackstone Medical Services that texts are not telephone calls under 47 U.S.C. 227(c)(5). In federal courts in Illinois, Indiana and Wisconsin such a suit cannot rest on texts alone.
The Swedish government announced an inquiry into telephone sales that will examine an opt-in requirement and a possible ban. The report is due by 15 January 2027.
Since 1 July 2026 a company may phone a Dutch consumer, sole proprietor, vof or maatschap to sell something only with explicit prior consent. The customer exception was removed for most companies.

A resolution of Spain's Secretary of State for Telecommunications gave the 400 code to commercial calls. Since 17 October 2026, sales calls in Spain must come from a nine-digit number starting with 400.
CMS's Contract Year 2027 final rule removed the requirement that 48 hours pass between completing the Scope of Appointment and the appointment itself, while keeping the advance agreement.
The Bundesnetzagentur fined a seller of finance and insurance products €50,000. Its callers posed as an independent advice service and disguised the sales purpose. The fine is not final.
The Ninth Circuit held in Howard v. Republican National Committee that a text is a call under 227(b), the autodialer and prerecorded-voice provision. The plaintiff still lost.

Belgium's data protection authority (APD) issued opinion 02/2026 on a bill that would make live sales calls opt-in and raise the sanction from level 2 to level 4. As of August 2026 the regime was still described as opt-out.
AGCOM has had carriers block international calls that spoof an Italian mobile number since late November 2025, extending an earlier block on spoofed fixed numbers under the same 2025 resolution.
